title: acme.shop.PlaceOrder v1.0
description: The canonical JSON `body` of acme.shop.PlaceOrder, projected from 7K.
$comment:
This schema is not equivalent validation. 7K's checker is authoritative, and the
following declared constraints are weaker here or absent entirely:

  Money.amount — range: not expressed. `range 0..` cannot be expressed over a string, which is how a decimal encodes so that it never round-trips through a double
  Money.currency — normalize: not expressed. `normalize upper` is a transformation and JSON Schema is a predicate language, so an unnormalized value validates here and 7K would have rewritten it
  OrderLine.sku — normalize: not expressed. `normalize upper` is a transformation and JSON Schema is a predicate language, so an unnormalized value validates here and 7K would have rewritten it
  PlaceOrder — invariant: not expressed. `total.currency == lines.[].unit.currency` relates fields, which this schema does not check
  PlaceOrder — nominal value: not expressed. 5 value types across 5 fields collapse to their base here (CardToken, CurrencyCode, OrderRef, Qty, Sku), so a payload validates with the right shape in the wrong field
